output.reason: [ev-e54c7ef2acc9] says support for the 1.20 compatibilityProfile was removed and that ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING and VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT were removed from Istio entirely. Values set for them are therefore no longer honoured, so setting-ignored fits. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, so the proposed "or cause failures" is unsupported. The evidence also doesn't call ENABLE_AUTO_SNI an alternative; it only says that flag was not removed.

correction.statement: Istio 1.24.0 removed support for the 1.20 compatibilityProfile and removed ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING and VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT entirely. Selecting that profile or setting those flags no longer applies the 1.20 behaviour.

consequence.statement: Selecting the 1.20 compatibilityProfile, or setting ENABLE_EXTERNAL_NAME_ALIAS, PERSIST_OLDEST_FIRST_HEURISTIC_FOR_VIRTUAL_SERVICE_HOST_MATCHING or VERIFY_CERTIFICATE_AT_CLIENT, is no longer honoured after the upgrade, because support for the profile and these flags was removed from Istio.
consequence.remediation: Remove references to the 1.20 compatibilityProfile and to the removed flags, and check that the current default behaviour suits your mesh. ENABLE_AUTO_SNI was not removed and can still be set explicitly.
